name: Berry Berry Berry
summary:
**The berries are waiting. Your vacuum is ready. The locals seem happy to see you. Maybe a little too happy.**

Welcome to **Berry Berry Berry**, a colorful first-person adventure through a garden with a strange side.

- **Vacuum up berries.** Grab your vacuum and get collecting as you explore the garden.
- **Experiment with curious tools.** Discover unusual equipment with a personality of its own.
- **Meet the locals.** Get acquainted with an oddly charming cast of suspiciously friendly faces.
